s.en: generate an index to an archive

o.en: Show the version number of ranlib.

Operate in deterministic mode. The symbol map archive member's header will show zero for the UID, GID, and timestamp. When this option is used, multiple runs will produce identical output files. If binutils was configured with --enable-deterministic-archives, then this mode is on by default.
Update the timestamp of the symbol map of an archive.

Do not operate in deterministic mode. This is the inverse of the -D option, above: the archive index will get actual UID, GID, timestamp, and file mode values. If binutils was configured without --enable-deterministic-archives, then this mode is on by default.
